stance: Inflation is re-accelerating. September headline CPI rose 0.649% m/m and 3.738% y/y (from 3.397%), driven largely by energy. Core rose 0.335% m/m and 2.564% y/y (from 2.446%), above the single-bank forecast of 0.20% m/m. Core PCE y/y at 2% remains the Fed gauge, so cut expectations face pushback. Playbook is yields up, USD up, equities down. No history yet, so treat as one print. Would soften if PPI and ISM Prices Paid cool and core m/m returns to 0.2% or below.
